title: The ATPase activity of yeast chromosome axis protein Hop1 affects the frequency of meiotic crossovers.
authors: Dhyani, Kshitiza M; Dash, Suman; Joshi, Sameer; Garg, Aditi; Pal, Debnath; Nishant, Koodali T; Muniyappa, Kalappa
one_liner_zh: 该文研究酵母减数分裂染色体轴蛋白Hop1的ATPase活性及其对DNA结合和交叉频率的影响，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作和分子动力学模拟，但核心对象非TF-DNA体系，方法可迁移性有限。
abstract: Saccharomyces cerevisiae meiosis-specific Hop1, a structural constituent of the synaptonemal complex, also facilitates the formation of programmed DNA double-strand breaks and the pairing of homologous chromosomes. Here, we reveal a serendipitous discovery that Hop1 possesses robust DNA-independent ATPase activity, although it lacks recognizable sequence motifs required for ATP binding and hydrolysis. By leveraging molecular docking combined with molecular dynamics simulations and biochemical assays, we identified an ensemble of five amino acid residues in Hop1 that could potentially participate in ATP-binding and hydrolysis. Consistent with this premise, we found that Hop1 binds to ATP and that substitution of amino acid residues in the putative ATP-binding site significantly impaired its ATPase activity, suggesting that this activity is intrinsic to Hop1. Notably, K65A and N67Q substitutions in the Hop1 N-terminal HORMA domain synergistically abolished its ATPase activity, noticeably impaired its DNA-binding affinity and reduced its association with meiotic chromosomes, while enhancing the frequency of meiotic crossovers (COs). Overall, our study establishes Hop1 as a DNA-independent ATPase and reveals a potential biological function for its ATPase activity in the regulation of meiotic CO frequency.
abstract_zh: 酿酒酵母减数分裂特异的Hop1蛋白，作为联会复合体的结构组分，也促进程序性DNA双链断裂的形成及同源染色体的配对。在此，我们揭示了一个偶然发现：Hop1具有强大的不依赖DNA的ATP酶活性，尽管它缺乏已知的ATP结合和水解所需识别序列基序。通过结合分子对接、分子动力学模拟及生化实验，我们鉴定了Hop1中一组五个氨基酸残基，它们可能参与ATP结合和水解。与此前提一致，我们发现Hop1能结合ATP，且推定ATP结合位点中的氨基酸残基替换显著损害其ATP酶活性，表明该活性是Hop1固有的。值得注意的是，Hop1 N端HORMA结构域中的K65A和N67Q替换协同消除了其ATP酶活性，显著削弱了其DNA结合亲和力，并减少了其与减数分裂染色体的关联，同时提高了减数分裂交叉（COs）的频率。总体而言，我们的研究将Hop1确立为一种不依赖DNA的ATP酶，并揭示了其ATP酶活性在调控减数分裂CO频率中的潜在生物学功能。
